fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a black motorcycle bearing registration number TN-39-XX-1048 belonging to the complainant was taken from Vaigai Park Parking Area. The matter was brought to Chennai South PS on 2026-04-24, while the incident was placed on 2026-04-24 around 21:10 hrs. Latha Sekar reported the matter orally at Chennai South PS; the contact number given was 9000000043. A further person, Siva Muthu, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000256, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Yuvaraj Natarajan, associated with the number 9000000298, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, vehicle observation, associate, night, mobile number, CCTV, motorcycle
